correctness.rationale: The primary source proves that the correlation dimension is the unique zero of the strictly increasing pressure \(P(s)=\log r(K_s)\). The included outward interval certificate proves on an exhaustive cover of \([0,1]\) that the twelve-branch positive truncation satisfies \(K^{(12)}_{0.847}g-g>1/25000\) for \(g(x)=1+(127/120)x\). The infinite tail is positive, and \(g\le247/120\), giving \(K_{0.847}g\ge(1+3/154375)g\). Iteration gives a spectral radius strictly above one, hence \(D_2<0.847\). The Fourier conclusion follows from the source inequality \(\eta_*\le D_2/2\).
